Yes, the protestor may be prosecuted. Dumping the trash is expressive conduct, but the ordinance is content-neutral and generally applicable. It serves an important, legitimate interest in keeping public parks clean, and it isn't aimed at suppressing communication (*O'Brien*, *Texas v. Johnson*). Any incidental burden on speech is no greater than necessary, because the protestor could have conveyed the message without leaving trash behind.

CONFIDENCE: 88
